title: The trouble store's root answers through a door that imports nothing heavy
intention: Whoever needs the trouble store's path asks cairn/devices/trouble/store.py, a module that imports only the address door, so asking for a path never pulls the trouble device's fold path, the bus client or a socket onto the caller's import graph.
why: Measured 2026-10-13: d48d54dccde6's PROVED crossing was refused by fire_path_unreachable and component_color (test_inspector_nexus.py red): cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py imports socket and is reachable from cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py along inspector -> cairn.tools.base.transitions -> cairn.devices.trouble.trouble -> cairn.devices.trouble.shim -> cairn.tools.base.shim -> cairn.tools.bus_client.remote. The transitions -> trouble.trouble edge came in with 4ddc9df3369e's build (3024a302, 2026-10-12) asking trouble.trouble for store_root. A verdict that can reach a host 'returns an opinion wearing a measurement's clothes' (the nexus proof). The peer (akiendelllinux_cc_0) asked for this fix in this lane, including the RULE 1 charter entry and the import-only tooth.
traces_to: RULE 1 (callers reach a component only through its declared public_interface) and the inspector nexus's fire-path rule (cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector_nexus.py: a verdict may not reach a tree, a database or a host); Law 4 (the rule is physics: the sieve).
how: cairn/devices/trouble plus five callers' import lines. (a) NEW cairn/devices/trouble/store.py: imports only __future__.annotations, pathlib.Path and cairn.tools.base.address.log_path; def store_root(roots: dict | None = None) -> Path returning log_path('cairn', 0, roots) / 'troubletickets' (the body moved verbatim from trouble.py:117-120). (b) trouble.py: the def store_root block is replaced by 'from cairn.devices.trouble.store import store_root' (a re-export; trouble.py keeps its log_path import for its other uses). (c) these five lines change 'from cairn.devices.trouble.trouble import store_root' to 'from cairn.devices.trouble.store import store_root': cairn/tools/base/transitions.py (_trouble_folders), cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py (_trouble_store), cairn/tools/base/probes/does_the_bounce_blame_the_right_party.py, cairn/tools/base/probes/does_the_mail_lane_get_worked.py, cairn/tools/operator_inbox/probes/operator_inbox_matches_live_state.py. (d) the trouble charter's public_interface appends 'cairn.devices.trouble.store', written through the artifact door.
falsifier: cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_the_store_root_is_a_light_door.py under PROVES {'03ea6f93df03': {'1','2','3','4'}}: (1) store.py imports nothing beyond the standard library and cairn.tools.base.address, at any depth; (2) store_root() == log_path('cairn',0)/'troubletickets', and with injected roots it follows them; (3) cairn.devices.trouble.trouble.store_root is cairn.devices.trouble.store.store_root; (4) the trouble charter's public_interface names cairn.devices.trouble.store. And cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector_nexus.py test_the_fire_path_never_reaches_the_tree green. Hollow: before the build store.py is absent, 1-4 red, and the nexus fire-path tooth reds on transitions -> trouble.trouble -> ... -> bus_client.remote (socket).
